# conDitar

This directory contains conDitar, which MADDIE's HitIdentifier uses for
structure-based molecule generation. It is the work of its authors and is
included here so that a MADDIE campaign can be reproduced from a single
checkout. Paths to model checkpoints in `configs/sample.yml` are placeholders
and must be set before use.

If you use this component, please cite:

> R. Gao, J. Peng, Z. Chen, F. N. Baker, et al. *Generating Developable 3D
> Molecules via Pocket-Conditioned Diffusion and Property-Aware Optimization.*
> arXiv:2607.12349, 2026. https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.12349
